title: Cake Assembly Line
statementMd:
A cake assembly line in a bakery was once again optimized, and now $n$ cakes are made at a time! In the last step, each of the $n$ cakes should be covered with chocolate.

Consider a side view on the conveyor belt, let it be a number line. The $i$-th cake occupies the segment $[a_i - w, a_i + w]$ on this line, each pair of these segments does not have common points. Above the conveyor, there are $n$ dispensers, and when a common button is pressed, chocolate from the $i$-th dispenser will cover the conveyor segment $[b_i - h, b_i + h]$. Each pair of these segments also does not have common points.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/266e34ff88ed8dd8bd721aeb256ecea26b761f43.png) Cakes and dispensers corresponding to the first example.

The calibration of this conveyor belt part has not yet been performed, so you are to make it. Determine if it's possible to shift the conveyor so that each cake has some chocolate on it, and there is no chocolate outside the cakes. You can assume that the conveyour is long enough, so the cakes never fall. Also note that the button can only be pressed once.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/436eeb1299ffb3a0585a14e752d77d3ebe882d7e.png) In the first example we can shift the cakes as shown in the picture.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^5$). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains three integers $n$, $w$, and $h$ ($1 \le n \le 10^5$; $1 \le w, h \le 10^5$; $h \le w$) — the number of cakes and dispensers, as well as the halfwidths of cakes and segments on which the chocolate is dispensed.

The second line contains $n$ integers $a_1$, $a_2$, ..., $a_n$ ($1 \le a_i \le 10^9$) — the positions of the cakes centers. It is guaranteed that $a_i + w \lt a_{i + 1} - w$ for all $i$.

The third line contains $n$ integers $b_1$, $b_2$, ..., $b_n$ ($1 \le b_i \le 10^9$) — the positions of the dispensers. It is guaranteed that $b_i + h \lt b_{i + 1} - h$ for all $i$.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $10^5$.

## Output

For each test case output "`YES`", if it's possible to shift the conveyor in such a way that each cake ends up with some chocolate, and no chocolate is outside the cakes, and "`NO`" otherwise.

You can output the answer in any case (upper or lower). For example, the strings "`yEs`", "`yes`", "`Yes`", and "`YES`" will be recognized as positive responses.

## Note

The first example is shown in the figures in the statement.

In the second example, we can move the conveyor, for example, so that the centers of the cakes are at $4, 9, 14, 19, 24$.

In the third example, we can't move the conveyor accordingly.
statementZhMd:
面包店的蛋糕装配线又一次进行了优化，现在一次可以制作 $n$ 个蛋糕！在最后一步，需要给这 $n$ 个蛋糕中的每一个都覆盖上巧克力。

从侧面观察传送带，并将其视为一条数轴。第 $i$ 个蛋糕在线上占据线段 $[a_i - w, a_i + w]$，任意两个这样的线段都没有公共点。在传送带上方有 $n$ 个分配器，按下同一个按钮时，第 $i$ 个分配器会将巧克力覆盖到传送带上的线段 $[b_i - h, b_i + h]$。任意两个这样的线段也没有公共点。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/266e34ff88ed8dd8bd721aeb256ecea26b761f43.png) 第一个样例中对应的蛋糕和分配器。

传送带这一部分尚未完成校准，因此需要你来完成校准。请判断是否可以移动传送带，使得每个蛋糕上都有一些巧克力，并且蛋糕外没有巧克力。你可以假设传送带足够长，因此蛋糕永远不会掉落。另请注意，按钮只能按下一次。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/436eeb1299ffb3a0585a14e752d77d3ebe882d7e.png) 在第一个样例中，我们可以像图中所示那样移动蛋糕。

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例数量 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^5$）。接下来描述各个测试用例。

每个测试用例的第一行包含三个整数 $n$、$w$ 和 $h$（$1 \le n \le 10^5$；$1 \le w, h \le 10^5$；$h \le w$）——蛋糕和分配器的数量，以及蛋糕和巧克力所覆盖线段的半宽。

每个测试用例的第二行包含 $n$ 个整数 $a_1$、$a_2$、...、$a_n$（$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$）——蛋糕中心的位置。保证对于所有 $i$，都有 $a_i + w \lt a_{i + 1} - w$。

每个测试用例的第三行包含 $n$ 个整数 $b_1$、$b_2$、...、$b_n$（$1 \le b_i \le 10^9$）——分配器的位置。保证对于所有 $i$，都有 $b_i + h \lt b_{i + 1} - h$。

保证所有测试用例中 $n$ 的总和不超过 $10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，如果可以移动传送带，使得每个蛋糕最终都能覆盖到一些巧克力，且蛋糕外没有巧克力，则输出“`YES`”；否则输出“`NO`”。

答案可以使用任意大小写形式输出（大写或小写均可）。例如，字符串“`yEs`”、“`yes`”、“`Yes`”和“`YES`”都会被识别为肯定答案。

## 说明

第一个样例如题面中的图片所示。

在第二个样例中，我们可以移动传送带，例如使蛋糕中心位于 $4, 9, 14, 19, 24$。

在第三个样例中，我们无法以相应的方式移动传送带。
